pages.en:
Jim Marshall, Hurt
In Panay Bombing,
Sailing For U.S.

Mr. Jim Marshall, staff writer
of Collier's Weekly who was
severely injured when the U.S.S.
Panay and three Standard Oil
ships were bombed near Nanking
December 12, will return to the
United States in the s.s. Empress
of Russia, sailing January 28. He
will be accompanied by Mrs.
Marshall, who flew to China to
join him soon after his
arrival here last September. They
intend to spend the next year at
their home in Seattle.

Physicians attending Mr.
Marshall have told him that
complete recovery from his in-
juries will require a year. His
left arm is still useless and causes
him great pain. He speaks only
with difficulty, owing to injury
suffered by his vocal cords.

Mr. Marshall left the Country
Hospital 10 days ago and is living
at the Cathay Hotel while await-
ing the departure of his steamer

吉姆·马歇尔在“帕奈”号轰炸事件中受伤，
将乘船返回美国。

《科利尔周刊》（Collier's Weekly）的专职撰稿人吉姆·马歇尔先生于12月12日在美国海军炮舰“帕奈”号（U.S.S. Panay）及三艘美孚石油公司（Standard Oil）船只于南京附近遭轰炸时受重伤，他将于1月28日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后”号轮船（s.s. Empress of Russia）返回美国。陪同他的是马歇尔夫人，她于去年九月马歇尔抵达中国后不久便飞抵中国与他会合。他们打算明年在西雅图的家中度过。

负责诊治马歇尔先生的医生告诉他，完全康复需要一年时间。他的左臂仍然无法活动，并给他带来剧烈疼痛。由于声带受损，他说话十分困难。

马歇尔先生于十天前离开乡村医院（Country Hospital），目前在等待轮船启航期间暂住华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
S.I, Special Branch ............,
REPORT
Date December 14, 1937.

Subject. Advertisement in personal column of the North China
Daily News
Made by D.S. Larby Forwarded by C. Crawford A J.

The advertisement, attached hereto, which appeared
in the personal column of the North China Daily News on
December 7th, 8th and 9th, was inserted on the instructions
of Mrs. J. Marshall, American, who is at present residing
at the Cathay Hotel, Room 540.

Mrs. Marshall is the wife of Mr. James Marshall,
American, Far Eastern Correspondent for Collier's
Magazine, who is at present on board H.M.S. Bee subsequent
to his rescue from the U.S.S. Panay on December 12 when
the latter vessel was sunk by bombs from Japanese planes
some 25 miles upriver from Nanking.

For the most part, Mrs. Marshall remains in her
room, engaged in the typing of reports which are
subsequently mailed to the U.S.A. for publication in
Collier's Magazine.

Enquiries among local educational circles and
returned students' associations have so far failed to
result in any information regarding Doctor Tsi, to whom
the message in the advertisement is addressed, being
forthcoming.

D.C. (Special Branch).

K.J. Larby
D. S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 ____ 
特别支部 S.I, ____ ，
报告
日期：1937年12月14日。

事由：《字林西报》（North China Daily News）个人专栏刊登的广告
由 D.S. Larby 制作，由 C. Crawford A J. 转呈

随函附上的广告曾于12月7日、8日和9日刊登在《字林西报》的个人专栏中，该广告是应现居华懋饭店540房间的美籍人士 J. 马歇尔夫人的指示刊登的。

马歇尔夫人是美籍人士詹姆斯·马歇尔先生的妻子。马歇尔先生是《科利尔杂志》（Collier's Magazine）的远东通讯员。12月12日，“帕奈”号在南京上游约25英里处被日本飞机投掷的炸弹击沉，马歇尔先生获救后目前身处英国皇家海军“蜜蜂”号（H.M.S. Bee）舰上。

马歇尔夫人大部分时间待在房间内，忙于打字撰写报告，随后将这些报告寄往美国，以便在《科利尔杂志》上发表。

经向当地教育界及归国留学生协会查询，迄今未能获得任何关于广告中所致信的季博士（Doctor Tsi）的消息。

特别支部警探 D.C.

K.J. Larby
D. S.
